ns2:course.label: Health Promotion Practicum
ns2:course.description: (CHLTH 240) Preparation and presentation of lifestyle workshops to campus community groups. Practica selected from one or more of the following topics: chemical education, sexuality, stress management or campus acquaintance rape education (CARE). May be repeated up to 1 time(s). Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Junior standing, or consent of instructor.
